results.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science | OpenAI
results.description: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

results.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work | OpenAI
results.description: Terminal-Bench 4.0 tests agents on complex terminal-based tasks, including software engineering, system configuration, and data analysis. GPT‑6 Astra reaches a new high at 57.9%, compared with 37.3% for GPT‑5.6 Sol2 and 55.8% for Claude Fable 5.1, at approximately 9% and 63% lower estimated API cost per task, respectively.
